description: Pull campaign performance summary from ALL configured Klaviyo accounts. Returns a unified cross-brand report. Rate limited: 2/min per account - may take several minutes for many accounts.

conversion_metric_ids.description: Map of account name → Placed Order metric ID (from the klaviyo skill table). STRONGLY recommended: accounts often have duplicate "Placed Order" metrics and auto-discovery can pick the wrong one (revenue reads $0). Keys match names from list_accounts.

end.description: Custom range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

quarter.description: Quarter 1-4 (with year) - convenience for a full quarter.

start.description: Custom range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides timeframe. Data floor: 2023-06-01 (earlier is clamped).

timeframe.description: Preset period. Default: last_30_days. Ignored if a custom range is given.

name: multi_account_summary
